_meta.title: Daniel — key verses (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Curated key verses from Daniel (praise to the God of wisdom and power, 'our God is able to deliver,' the shut lions' mouths, the wise who shine like stars). Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 27 Daniel); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight

verses.text: Daniel answered and said, Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever: for wisdom and might are his:
verses.plain: Daniel said: Praise be to the name of God forever and ever; wisdom and power are his.

verses.text: If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king.
verses.plain: If we are thrown into the blazing furnace, the God we serve is able to deliver us from it, and he will deliver us from your hand, O king.

verses.text: My God hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions' mouths, that they have not hurt me: forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me; and also before thee, O king, have I done no hurt.
verses.plain: My God sent his angel, and he shut the mouths of the lions. They have not hurt me, because I was found innocent in his sight.

verses.text: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.
verses.plain: Those who are wise will shine like the brightness of the heavens, and those who lead many to righteousness, like the stars forever and ever.
